resources.string: 0 uses automatic routing. Music prefers an available media BUS; navigation uses the system notification policy, with system fallback on failure. Select an audio stream to choose and preview it independently. Numbers do not identify speaker positions. Changes apply on the next connection.

Coordinate audio focus for music, navigation, Siri and calls. Mute on focus loss and lower app music during navigation or Siri playback. If enabling this causes silence on the vehicle, turn it off and reconnect.
